notes: SLOT 17 (03:35 IST fire / 2026-09-21 22:05 UTC) - WORK SLOT. Item 31, mobile-bridge reply dispatch honesty. BUG: src/components/MobileBridgeModal.tsx dispatchReply - the REPLY control on every PENDING_APPROVAL bridge event - asked for no approval, sent no HTTP request, and wrote the event state AUTHORIZED while speaking 'Reply authorized, Sir. Dispatching via the Android bridge when connected.' Its approval expression was `isExplicitApproval('yes') ? 'REPLY_AUTHORIZED' : 'REPLY_AUTHORIZED'` - both branches identical, so whatever it computed was discarded, and isExplicitApproval was never called with anything the user actually said. `/api/mobile/bridge/message/reply` refuses every request lacking `approved: true`, so each of those 'dispatches' claimed a call nobody made. FIX: new pure module src/utils/mobileReplyDispatchTruth.ts - replyDispatchDecision(...) refuses NOT_REPLY_EVENT / SENSITIVE_CONTENT / NO_REPLY_TEXT / NO_DISTINCT_APPROVAL and otherwise returns the verified body + notification id; replyDispatchOutcome(httpStatus, body) maps only the OBSERVED response to DISPATCHED | BLOCKED | FAILED | NOT_CONFIGURED | UNVERIFIED and never infers success from a transport status (2xx without the server's dispatch outcome = FAILED; a device-claimed `verified` is demoted to UNVERIFIED because confirmation is a separate route); replyDispatchSpeech / replyRefusalSpeech in English and Hindi never claim a reply was delivered. MobileBridgeModal.tsx now gives the operator a reply text field plus a distinct 'I APPROVE SENDING THIS REPLY' checkbox; without it nothing is requested and the event stays PENDING_APPROVAL (never AUTHORIZED); with no paired bridge session token it reports NOT_CONFIGURED instead of pretending; otherwise it POSTs the real request and drives event status, audit entry, notice and spoken line from the status and body it actually received. New test src/tests/mobileReplyDispatchTruth.test.ts (16 tests): the four refusal reasons, the distinct-approval requirement, the outcome mapping over 0/4xx/5xx/2xx bodies, plus source guards pinning absence of the identical-branch ternary, absence of an unsupervised AUTHORIZED write, and presence of the real route call. Negative validation: restoring the previous MobileBridgeModal.tsx fails exactly the 3 source guards, observed 3 failed | 13 passed of 16; restored -> 16/16. Observed gates: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npx vitest run 68 files / 979 tests passed; npm run build exit 0 (dist/server.cjs 852453 bytes / 832.5 kb).
